Ingest the unified BMF into entity, name and address

Source: R/md-ingest-bmf.R
md_ingest_bmf.Rd

Reads the pinned BMF parquet and writes the three core tables. Idempotent: a full load keyed on source_vintage, per §10, so re-running replaces rather than accumulating.

Usage

md_ingest_bmf(version, con = NULL, validate = TRUE)

md_validate_bmf(con)

Arguments

version

The pinned bmf_unified version, e.g. "v2026-08-11".

con

A connection from md_db(). Opened and closed here if NULL.

validate

Run md_validate() on each table and stop on failure.

Value

A named list of row counts, invisibly.

What this does and does not populate

The BMF is a snapshot, not a panel (§4), so this fills the identity spine and the current name and address. It writes the resolved-attribute columns as NULL and leaves them for md_ingest_ntee(), which reads the canonical NTEE crosswalk - the only source that can supply the rule and the agreement flag the triple requires. The BMF's own ntee_code_raw is carried through so the recomputation has its input, but the BMF's nteev2 rendering is deliberately not copied: it carries the specialty double-encoding defect (?md_ntee_canonical).

Layer assignment

bmf_active means "in the current active BMF release" (§3a), which in this file is last_vintage_ym equal to the newest vintage present. Everything else is bmf_inactive. status_code is carried separately rather than conflated with layer, because status is mutable and layer is provenance (§4).
